charm.how: Catch all 400 Pokémon in the Galar Pokédex, then talk to the Game Director at Hotel Ionia in Circhester.

methods.name: Random encounters
methods.plain: Any Pokémon you meet has a 1 in 4,096 chance to be shiny.
methods.detail: One try per Pokémon, 3 with the Shiny Charm. Only Brilliant Pokémon get the battled-count bonus.

methods.name: Masuda Method
methods.plain: Breed two Pokémon whose games are in different languages: the eggs have a much better shiny chance.
methods.detail: 6 tries per egg, 8 with the Shiny Charm.

methods.name: Breeding (same-language parents)
methods.plain: Ordinary eggs have the normal shiny chance; the Shiny Charm helps them too.
methods.detail: 1 try, 2 with the Shiny Charm. Quirk: with the charm but no Masuda Method an egg gets 2 tries, not 3, because the egg code skips the normal first try.
methods.note: Admiral-Fish RNGWriteups, Gen 8 Egg Generation: rolls = 6 for Masuda, +2 for the charm, no base try

methods.name: Brilliant Pokémon (number battled)
methods.plain: Defeat or catch lots of one species: its glowing Brilliant Pokémon get better shiny odds, best after 500.
methods.detail: Only Brilliant (aura) Pokémon get the bonus: +1 try, plus +1/+2/+3/+4/+5 at 50/100/200/300/500 battled. Brilliants also show up more often (1.3× from 20 battled, 1.6× from 50, 2× from 100).
methods.note: Anubis (@Sibuna_Switch) testing; Kaphotics. One guide counts the same totals as '+2 … +6' because it includes the Brilliant try.

methods.name: Dynamax Adventures
methods.plain: Every Pokémon you catch in a Dynamax Adventure, legendaries too, has a 1 in 300 shiny chance (1 in 100 with the Shiny Charm).
methods.detail: A flat chance per caught Pokémon, not tries.
methods.note: PKHeX Max Lair handling: made non-shiny, then forced shiny on a 1:300 (1:100 with charm) roll; RotomLabs agrees

methods.name: Max Raid Battles
methods.plain: Max Raid Pokémon are 1 in 4,096 and the Shiny Charm doesn't help.
methods.detail: The result is fixed when the den's beam appears.

methods.name: Curry visitors
methods.plain: Pokémon that come to your curry are 1 in 4,096; the Shiny Charm doesn't help.

methods.name: The Regis (Crown Tundra)
methods.plain: The six Regis can be shiny, but the Shiny Charm doesn't help.
